Against IDH mutation, the patient is older, the metadata reports a high necrosis proportion, and satellites are present, which can be seen in more aggressive IDH-wildtype tumors. Overall, the mismatch pattern and limited enhancement outweigh the age/aggressive-feature concerns, so the best estimate is IDH-mutant.
